title: Sandoz unveils plan for biosimilar expansion and new $300M factory in Slovenia
llm_note: Sandoz is investing $300 million to construct a new biosimilar manufacturing facility in Slovenia.

title: STAT+: FDA warns an API supplier about residue on walls, a corroded product line, and open-toed sandals
llm_note: The FDA issued a warning letter to Shoolin Pharma regarding unsanitary manufacturing conditions at their Indian facility.

title: Sandoz sets sights on 100 biosimilars in new 2040 strategy, with $300M facility build
llm_note: Sandoz announced a $300 million facility investment to support its long-term biosimilar manufacturing strategy.

title: ProBioGen Grants Transgene Additional License for AGE1.CR.pIX Cell Line
llm_note: Transgene licensed the AGE1.CR.pIX cell line from ProBioGen to expand its manufacturing production capabilities.
